role: no-premise derivability in the registered LTL calculus
notes: All derivations are finite; both temporal rules are theorem-only.

role: strict future until operator
notes: Witness strictly later; the left operand is required only strictly between endpoints.

role: local semantic premise consequence over infinite words
notes: Every premise holds at the evaluation position; no global-premise convention is introduced.

role: finitely supported local premise derivability
notes: Defined through a provable implication from a finite conjunction.

role: finite syntactic subformula set
notes: Abbreviations are expanded before forming this set.

role: subformula count and expanded formula length
notes: Here n is input length; indices of word positions remain bound variables in the semantic clauses.

role: Boolean truth record on the subformula set
notes: Maps each subformula to zero or one; Hilbert consistency and Boolean coherence are different restrictions.

role: positive and negative signed formula literals
notes: The superscript is a truth bit; it is not numerical exponentiation.

role: characteristic signed conjunction of a truth record
notes: Fixed finite ordering; it records every subformula truth bit.

role: set of Hilbert-consistent finite truth records
notes: Used for the existence proof; its consistency definition is not the decision algorithm.

role: consistency-based successor relation between truth records
notes: An edge says that the conjunction of the current characteristic formula and next successor characteristic formula is not refutable.

role: finite alphabet states permitted starts transition function and Buchi accepting set
notes: The current state describes the letter consumed by its outgoing transition.

role: all Boolean-coherent subformula truth records
notes: Effectively tested without a Hilbert-consistency oracle.

role: finite set of atoms in the input formula
notes: Its powerset is the alphabet of valuation letters.

role: effective one-step coherence relation on truth records
notes: Tests both next equality and non-strict until unfolding.

role: set and count of until subformulas
notes: Every member has a separate finite-witness obligation.

role: until obligations true but not currently witnessed in a record
notes: These obligations are collected when a pending batch is empty.

role: until obligations whose right operands hold currently
notes: Their pending copies may be removed in the next batch.

role: current and next pending obligation sets
notes: An accepting run must have an empty batch infinitely often; a single initial empty batch is insufficient.

role: ordinary Buchi automaton for the formula
notes: Product of local truth records and pending obligation batches.

role: finite list of generalized Buchi accepting sets
notes: Each set must recur; an empty list imposes no acceptance condition on an existing infinite run.

role: accepting set for one until subformula
notes: Contains records where that until is false or its right operand is true.

role: generalized Buchi local-type automaton
notes: Same letter-matching edges as the effective local automaton.

role: next required accepting-set index in the counter conversion
notes: Its transition update tests the current first-coordinate state; acceptance also requires actual last-set membership.

role: ordinary accepting set after generalized Buchi conversion
notes: A last-counter state alone is insufficient; its first coordinate must lie in the last required set.

role: zero-or-more and positive-length graph reachability
notes: The positive return prevents false acceptance of a loopless singleton.

role: number of automaton states for lasso length bounds
notes: A shortest reachable prefix has at most N minus one edges and a shortest positive return at most N.

role: finite word length and written formula length
notes: Its operand determines the domain; the cardinality bars retain their set-cardinality meaning.

role: finite total labelled transition structure with a single initial state
notes: Universal path checking uses the automaton for the syntactic negation.

role: complete encoded finite-model input length
notes: Includes state edge and label lists and is at least two; it is not a vector norm.

role: bounded graph reachability recursion
notes: Tests paths of length at most two to the power k including zero-length paths.

role: encoded automaton and product state bit lengths
notes: The deterministic recursive decision procedure uses quadratic workspace in the product encoding length.

role: cell alphabet for the fixed polynomial-space machine
notes: Boundary symbols ordinary tape symbols and state-symbol pairs; distinct from the automaton transition function.

role: polynomially bounded machine-configuration width
notes: Includes two permanent boundary cells and is at least three.

role: temporal formula encoding a machine computation on an input word
notes: Stationary accepting and rejecting configurations give the required infinite history.

role: configuration phases cell-symbol atoms head and accepting-head tests
notes: Exactly one phase cell symbol and configuration head are enforced.

role: finite exactly-one Boolean abbreviation
notes: Defined on a nonempty list; all uses expand to the registered Boolean language.

role: local next-cell update function of the fixed machine
notes: Its finite table and treatment of malformed triples are supplied in the hardness proof.

role: clock-block translation of temporal formulas
notes: Truth is compared only at phase-zero positions; next advances a full encoded block.

role: fresh model start phase-zero marker and valuation-bit atom
notes: The initial next step skips the fresh start and preserves the first encoded valuation.
